'''Chapter 79''' is titled "To Live".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] in a Wild West frontier town. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] is riding a huge black panther; [[Nami]] is lounging against a second, heavily drunk panther; [[Usopp]] is pointing a pistol straight ahead; and [[Sanji]] and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] are returning from a supply run, arms laden with bags and barrels.

==Short Summary==
After being kidnapped, [[Nami]] became a member of [[Arlong]]'s crew.

==Long Summary==
After [[Bell-mère]]'s death, [[Nami]] was kidnapped when Arlong discovered her ability for drawing maps. All the villagers decided to fight to take her back, but she suddenly came back by herself, revealing that she was now part of Arlong's crew. She even showed that she could earn all the money she wanted. Disgusted by this selfish behavior, the villagers rejected her. But when [[Nojiko]] went to her mother's grave, Nami was already sitting there. She explained to her sister that in order to accomplish their mother's last wish and live, they could not rebel against [[Arlong]] who was too strong for them. Instead she decided to draw maps for him, revealing that she would be able to buy her village back for {{B}}100,000,000.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Nami]]'s flashback continues.
**[[Arlong]] kidnaps Nami after discovering her cartography talents.
**[[Genzo]]'s scars come from a fight against [[Kuroobi]].
**Nami joins the [[Arlong Pirates]].
**Arlong decides to release his hold on the village if Nami gives him {{B}}100,000,000.

==Trivia==
*In the chapter's initial publishing in ''[[Weekly Shonen Jump]]'', the first two story pages were printed in full color.
*This chapter's cover page was—redrawn to remove [[Sanji]] and include [[Gill Bastar]] and [[Wild Joe]]—featured in the credits montage of ''[[One Piece: The Movie]]''.
*This is the second cover wherein Nami appears as one of the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] while she is actually still with the Arlong Pirates.
